article.story: EDWARDSVILLE, Ill. -- — Darrion Baker had 20 points in SIU Edwardsville's 66-62 win against Lindenwood on Tuesday night. Baker also had nine rebounds for the Cougars (10-6, 3-2 Ohio Valley Conference). Kyle Thomas scored 13 points and added five rebounds. Tyler King finished with 12 points. The Lions (10-6, 4-1) were led by Jadis Jones, who posted 22 points, 14 rebounds and three steals. Dontrez Williams added 14 points for Lindenwood. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
